claim_being_audited: Whether the model can be certified for launch based on the current packet despite missing evaluation coverage for the named deployment context of technician safety-note routing.

concern_ledger.concern: Missing evaluation coverage for technician safety-note routing, a named deployment context.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Completed evals for technician safety-note routing, or final certification artifacts disclosing the gap, or approved risk acceptance covering launch with the gap.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy requires named-context evaluation gaps to be disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance before certification; the packet shows the gap remains open.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence of disclosure or approved risk acceptance for the named-context gap.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Final model-card/certification package containing the disclosure, or approved risk-acceptance records.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Without disclosure or approved acceptance, certification does not meet the stated policy threshold.

concern_ledger.concern: Draft model-card language appears to understate the limitation by treating missing evals as no known limitation.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Revised final model-card language accurately disclosing the unknown status or completed eval evidence removing the uncertainty.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: This conflicts with QA's admissible position that the missing coverage should be treated as unknown, undermining the integrity of the certification basis.

decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if named deployment-context evaluation gaps are resolved, explicitly disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness, rehearsal results, and general operational checks can support launch readiness but do not by themselves satisfy named-context disclosure requirements.
Conflicting or overbroad model-card statements about limitations weigh against compliance when the admissible record says coverage is still unknown.
evidence_requests: Provide the final certification/model-card artifact showing explicit disclosure of the technician safety-note-routing evaluation gap.
Provide approved risk-acceptance documentation specifically covering launch with this named-context evaluation gap.
Provide completed evaluation results for technician safety-note routing that close the current coverage gap.
Provide any materiality determination showing why this named launch use case would not require disclosure under the stated policy.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows technician safety-note routing is a named deployment context and its evals are not present in the packet.
The policy requires disclosure of material limitations and evaluation gaps for named deployment contexts unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
No admissible evidence shows the gap was disclosed in the certification artifact or covered by approved risk acceptance.
The draft model-card statement treating missing evals as effectively no limitation conflicts with QA's view that the status is unknown, which weakens the certification basis.
unsupported_claims: That the current packet supports clean certification of the model for launch.
Any implication that missing technician safety-note-routing evals can be treated as passed because no completed test failed.
Any implication that general support, latency, rollback, and aggregate readiness results substitute for named-context evaluation coverage required by policy.
